name: mdadDesk
description: MadadDesk: AI-assisted building emergency SOS and coordination

paragraphs: From scattered distress messages to a verified emergency picture. A building-emergency SOS app: a person in trouble sends an SOS, a coordinator verifies it and sends Fire / Ambulance / Police, the agency taps "On the way", and the reporter sees every step live.

Prototype for drills and demos only — not a deployed emergency service. In a real emergency call 1122. Live demo: (installable as an app on Android and iPhone). Demo video: Staff demo logins are shared privately with judges and testers.
features: Role-based pages: public sees "Report SOS", coordinator sees "Desk", agency sees "Inbox"
(enforced in the app and in firestore.rules).
No internet? After 5 seconds without delivery the reporter gets "Send by SMS" (pre-written
with location) and "Call 1122 (free)". The SMS goes to the coordinator's phone (VITESOSSMSNUMBER), not to the Desk: the coordinator reads it on that phone.
Installable PWA, works on phones, guided tours on first visit, calm UI with lucide icons.
